Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Actuarial Science, Computer Science, or related field (or the equivalent years of education and experience required).
5+ years in insurance (life/annuity/LTC or related) and/or TPA operations; Product Owner or similar experience strongly preferred.
Working knowledge of new business and underwriting practices, ACORD standards, and policy administration systems required.
Hands on experience in Agile/Kanban environments (flow metrics, WIP limits, continuous delivery).
Experience coordinating vendor deliverables/releases and supporting E2E/UAT readiness and defect triage.
Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for work tracking and documentation; experience with process documentation tools (Miro, Visio, Lucidchart, etc.)

Required Skills and Experience:

Leadership and Communication
Ability to lead and influence cross functional teams without direct authority.
Clear, candid written and verbal communication; able to explain complex topics to technical and non technical audiences.
Strong stakeholder management skills; able to set expectations, build trust, and drive timely decisions.
Analytical and Delivery Skills
Strong analytical mindset with focus on measurable business outcomes and customer impact.
Ability to translate insurance concepts and regulatory requirements into actionable delivery work items.
Comfort working with configuration heavy platforms and data mapping (e.g., inbound application/ACORD data, outbound extracts/reporting, forms/correspondence).

Definitions:

Definition of Ready (DoR)
Business objective and scope clearly stated; success metrics defined where applicable.
Business rules and state/product variations documented.
Data impacts identified (inbound forms/ACORD fields, outbound extracts/reporting, data tags/forms impacts as applicable).
Acceptance criteria and test approach documented (unit/UAT/E2E expectations).
Dependencies and risks identified with owners.
Definition of Done (DoD)
Acceptance criteria met and validated; evidence captured. (screenshots/logs/test results as appropriate).
Documentation updated (Confluence/runbook/packet matrix/requirements artifacts).
Traceability maintained (requirement, story, validation, release).
Operational readiness confirmed for production (monitoring/notifications, support handoff, rollback considerations where applicable).

Success Metrics (Examples)

Reduction in cycle time from requirement intake to production release.
Reduction in rework (story churn/reopens) due to requirements gaps.
Defect leakage reduction (prod defects attributable to requirements/packet defects).
Backlog health (aging WIP, predictable throughput).
Stakeholder satisfaction and on time delivery against committed milestones.

About Base

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.

About the Role

You will own and improve the core products, systems, and experiences that drive customer acquisition, activation, and retention. Some of that work will involve improving our existing funnel and website experience. Much of it will involve building entirely new growth products and infrastructure from scratch.

You will work across Growth, Engineering, Design, Operations, and Marketing to identify the highest-leverage opportunities in the customer journey and turn them into shipped products that materially improve business performance.

This role sits at the intersection of product, growth, analytics, and strategy. You might redesign a critical onboarding flow, launch a self-serve enrollment experience, rethink how we qualify and route customers, build internal growth tooling, or drive entirely new strategic bets that reshape how customers join and engage with Base.

A core part of the role is judgment. You will help decide where we create leverage, what friction matters, what tradeoffs are acceptable, and which problems are worth solving. We care deeply about conversion performance, but not at the expense of clarity, trust, or long-term brand quality.

You'll operate in a lean environment where speed matters and ownership is high. We are not looking for someone to manage a roadmap handed to them. We are looking for someone who can identify opportunities independently, work from first principles, and drive execution across ambiguous, cross-functional problems.

What You'll Do

Own and improve critical parts of Base’s acquisition, activation, and retention funnel: from first touch through long-term engagement.

Identify and execute large strategic bets that materially improve growth performance, scalability, or customer experience.

Build new growth products and systems from scratch, including self-serve flows, onboarding experiences, lifecycle products, referral systems, internal tooling, and funnel infrastructure.

Partner closely with engineering, design, analytics, operations, and growth teams to ship high-quality customer experiences quickly.

Define and improve product measurement: instrumentation, events, funnels, experimentation frameworks, attribution hygiene, and operational reporting.

Develop a deep understanding of customer behavior, operational constraints, and funnel performance to identify the highest-leverage opportunities.

Run experiments across onboarding, routing, messaging, qualification, activation, retention, and lifecycle experiences — while maintaining a coherent and trustworthy customer experience.

Contribute directly to implementation when needed, whether through lightweight front-end work, analytics tooling, product configuration, or rapid prototyping.

Help define how product and growth operate together at Base as the company scales.

What You'll Bring

You’ve owned a website, funnel, or product with measurable outcomes.

Analytics fluency: you define your own events, build your own funnels, and write SQL to answer questions without waiting for a data team.

Design judgment: you can evaluate layout, hierarchy, and interaction patterns and give engineers and designers useful direction.

Ability to operate in an unstructured environment and keep work moving without process holding you up.

Preferred Skills

Web / front-end application experience — you've shipped production sites or applications.

SEO fundamentals: on-page structure, technical hygiene, tooling (Semrush, Ahrefs).

Figma fluency.

Familiarity with PostHog or similar product analytics tools.

AI fluency.

About This Team

The Growth team sets the pace for how fast Base can deliver affordable, reliable power to the people who need it. We operate as one team across marketing, sales, support, product, and design, lean and high-ownership. Everything we build comes back to one question: are we solving people's problems? We're building the world's most beloved energy company.

Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.

Our Values

First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.

Do the best work of your life at Base.

DESCRIPTION

Amazon Robotics is transforming the future of fulfillment by deploying autonomous mobile robots, robotic manipulation systems, and AI-driven orchestration software across hundreds of fulfillment centers that collectively move billions of packages a year. As a Technical Product Launch Manager I, you will support the end-to-end launch of next-generation robotics technologies directly into Amazon's live operational network, working under the guidance of senior product launch managers. Your work will have immediate, measurable impact: the systems you help launch will reduce customer delivery times, improve associate safety, and drive operational efficiency at a scale few roles anywhere in the world can match.

The Product Launch team is the critical bridge between Amazon Robotics Engineering & Product and Amazon Operations & Maintenance during the rollout of new automation solutions that are being built in production through fast iteration. You will develop foundational expertise in breakthrough technologies, supporting engineering triages, contributing to performance deep dives, and translating field observations into product improvements that shape the engineering roadmap. You will contribute to training development from the associate level up to senior leadership, build customer relationships, and support adoption across a network that never stops growing.

We are looking for a builder who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, leads with data, and earns trust through reliable execution. You dive deep into the details without losing sight of the bigger picture. You simplify the complex, champion your customers, and bring a doer mindset to every challenge. If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you.

Key job responsibilities
1. [Ownership] Support end-to-end launch and field testing of new automation solutions; track deliverables, flag project risks, and contribute to status reports under guidance from senior program managers.
2. [Customer Obsession] Develop foundational expertise in site operations and maintenance, build relationships with site customers, and represent their perspective in product discussions.
3. [Dive Deep] Monitor performance, availability, and quality metrics during field tests; identify patterns and escalate root causes to engineering, contributing findings to prioritized product and process improvements.
4. [Invent and Simplify] Assist in evaluating user roles against product requirements, maintain a prioritized feature backlog, and surface high-impact improvement opportunities in engineering roadmap and sprint reviews.
5. [Deliver Results] Drive launch readiness by developing user training content, from associate standard work to leadership-level theory-of-operations material; ensure site teams are prepared to operate and sustain new automation solutions by delivering training milestones on schedule and validating completeness prior to go-live.
6. [Earn Trust] Execute day-to-day field testing tasks, support site leadership communications for changes, and triage operational issues arising from NPI activities to help keep launches on schedule.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with a stand-up at a fulfillment center, reviewing overnight performance data for a robotic system beta test. You spot an availability anomaly, flag it to the engineering team, and help triage the issue by gathering logs and testing a firmware edge case. By mid-morning, you are facilitating hands-on training for technicians, delivering teardown procedures developed by your team earlier in the launch cycle.

After lunch, you shift to tactical execution, compiling field test data from multiple sites into a summary that your senior program launch manager will use in a product improvement proposal. You document patterns that could reduce maintenance time by 30%. You also join a retrospective to capture lessons learned and take ownership of updating the team's field observation template for the next launch.

Late afternoon, you update launch trackers, draft inputs for a status report that your manager will present to senior stakeholders, and coordinate logistics for an upcoming launch milestone. No two days are identical: some weeks you are deep in data collection, others you are boots-on-the-ground troubleshooting. What stays constant is the impact. The systems you help launch serve millions of customers, the observations you surface shape the engineering roadmap, and the processes you follow and refine make your entire team more effective.

Future Secure AI is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the AI layer of our enterprise agentic AI platform. You will be responsible for the evaluation of capability, trust and governance posture, observability and explainability primitives, and the agent-design patterns that engineering teams use to build AI Co-Workers for enterprise customers. Your goal is to make the AI layer reliable, auditable, and adoptable in regulated environments, so every AI Co-Worker built on the platform inherits enterprise-grade quality. You will operate as a peer of engineering and AI/ML leadership, with direct impact on whether AI Co-Workers reach scale in regulated industries.

Own the model and prompt lifecycle: how versions are introduced, evaluated, promoted, and retired, with change management appropriate to enterprise customers
Drive discovery through interviews with platform engineers, production behavior analysis, frontier research, and enterprise customer conversations, and prototype eval and guardrail primitives before committing engineering capacity
Partner closely with engineering leadership to ensure the platform delivers a reliable, intuitive experience for teams building agentic AI Co-Workers
Own value risk and viability risk: ensure engineering teams adopt your primitives as the fastest path to a reliable AI Co-Worker, and that governance, observability, and audit features satisfy enterprise compliance requirements

Demonstrated experience building or owning an evaluation suite for an AI feature in production, including offline benchmarks, online evals, regression evals, and rubric-based grading
Nuanced understanding of foundation models, agent architectures, and AI evaluation, with the ability to simplify that complexity for executive, business, and regulated-customer audiences
Direct experience with non-determinism in AI systems; able to write acceptance criteria that hold up under flaky model behavior and set quality SLAs that do not break the team
Experience shipping or working closely on a production agent system, with informed opinions on planning loops, tool use, memory, retries, guardrails, and when an agent is the wrong abstraction
Familiarity with NIST AI RMF and the EU AI Act, and the ability to map enterprise compliance requirements across banking, insurance, and healthcare to platform primitives
Experience living through an AI incident, root-causing it, and shipping the fix into the platform so downstream teams inherit the improvement

Preferred Qualifications

Background as an AI or ML PM at an enterprise AI platform, an AI tooling vendor, or a model lab
Experience in a product role at a regulated-industry AI team that has shipped to production
Familiarity with RAG patterns, eval tooling, agent frameworks, and the broader AI tools landscape
ML-leaning PM background at a company that has matured past the prototype phase

Experience world-class leadership

A competitive salary and a huge growth trajectory
Work with the best in the industry

ICON is hiring a Senior Product Manager to plan, coordinate, and deliver BuildOS: our software platform for design, construction planning, print execution, and fleet management, used by architects, project managers, and construction operators. In this role, you will apply strong product and program management skills to keep a multi-module software team focused, organized, and on schedule. You will run day-to-day delivery, partner with engineering leads, and connect the software team with robotics, field operations, and business development. You will share clear status with leadership, raise risks early, and help shape what gets built next.

This role is based at ICON's Austin, TX office and reports to the Director of Digital Product Experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Sprint and Release Execution: Plan sprints, track progress, and coordinate releases with the engineering team. Run standups, epic reviews, and retrospectives that stay focused and useful.
Plans and Reporting: Keep Jira plans, capacity, epic status, and risk logs current. Send weekly updates that give leadership a clear picture without follow-up questions.
Cross-Team Dependencies: Spot blockers early and help resolve them. Coordinate work across software, robotics, field operations, and business development. Speak up for the team's capacity in cross-team planning.
Field Requests: Help the team respond to requests from active construction projects without losing focus on planned work. Sort what is urgent, what can wait, and who needs to weigh in.
Roadmap Partnership: Work with the Director of Digital Product Experience to shape the roadmap and make tradeoffs. Bring real delivery data into planning conversations.
Help break large goals into sprint-ready work with engineering leads.
Risk and Decisions: Track what is slipping, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Share options clearly so leaders can move quickly.
Capacity and Quarterly Planning: Model capacity, sequence work, and check timelines during quarterly planning. Watch for workload that may lead to burnout and raise it early.
Process and Team Health: Improve practices that slow the team down. Onboard new team members into how the team plans and ships.
Mentorship and Cross-Functional Leadership: Coach other program managers and partners on planning practices that work. Advise cross-functional partners on delivery and prioritization questions.
Strategic Alignment: Connect team work to company-wide Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) so the day-to-day moves bigger goals forward.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

8+ years in product management, technical program management, or a hybrid role, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead role.
Track record running delivery for a software product with multiple teams or modules.
Strong fluency with Jira or similar tools. You have managed backlogs, sprint plans, and roadmaps at scale.
Experience coordinating work between software and hardware, operations, or field teams.
Clear communication across audiences. You can share a short update with a VP and dig into scope with an engineer in the same hour.
A history of protecting team capacity while keeping partner trust.
Comfort with shifting priorities. Construction work does not wait for a sprint to end.
Working knowledge of agile practices.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Ability to explain delivery status and tradeoffs to non-technical audiences and senior
leaders.
Curiosity and a steady appetite to learn.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Experience in construction technology, robotics, manufacturing, or another physical-
product field.
Background in technical program management at a growing company.
Familiarity with construction workflows, BIM tools, or field operations software.
Experience with government or defense contracts and their compliance needs.
Experience with products used in the field rather than at a desk, and the design choices

About Circuit

Circuit is the AI execution layer for the physical economy.

Industrial and manufacturing enterprises run on expertise: the hard-won knowledge of how complex products are engineered, configured, sold, and supported. That expertise is scarce, slow to transfer, and walking out the door as a generation of experts retires. It lives in PDFs, spreadsheets, and the heads of a few people, and the hardest technical decisions wait on whoever happens to know.

Circuit puts expert judgment in everyone's hands. We capture how the best people make critical technical decisions and turn it into agents that do the judgment-heavy work, so anyone, regardless of skill level, can make the right call, from quote to install and support, with the accuracy these environments demand.

Circuit is built by operators. Our leadership team has built and scaled real industrial companies, and we are already live in production with category-leading manufacturers. We are not bolting AI onto an old playbook. We are building the layer that runs the last mile of how the physical economy executes.

The Role

As a Senior Product Manager, you own the business outcomes of the products Circuit is selling and deploying into critical manufacturing and industrial businesses.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership, reporting directly to the co-founder and CPRO. You will work closely with engineering, design, sales, and customer support to identify user problems, design effective solutions, and ship them.

You will sit at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and the messy reality of how manufacturers actually work. You'll spend time with technicians on the floor and engineers in the codebase. You'll define what trust looks like in a product that runs in mission-critical environments, and turn complex manual processes into clean, automated workflows.

Product Ownership & Strategy

Own core product areas end to end: set the strategy, define the roadmap, and ship, with accountability for the outcomes including adoption, customer impact, and revenue

Act as the key translator between GTM, Engineering, and Product Design, converting customer and commercial signal into clear product direction and shared priorities

Customer & Field Insight

Work directly with technicians, dealers, and operators to understand their reality, then translate it into product

Partner with sales engineering to map customer workflows and turn them into reusable building blocks

Serve as the internal voice of the customer, synthesizing patterns across accounts and communicating priorities to Engineering and Leadership

Quality & Measurement

Define the metrics, build the feedback loops, and run the evals that tell us whether Circuit is getting better every week

Set the bar for accuracy and reliability, and the guardrails that earn user trust in the mission-critical settings Circuit runs in

Experience

7+ years in B2B product management, including time owning a technically complex or AI-powered product that you shipped and iterated on at scale. You know the distance between a compelling demo and a product that holds up in production

Proven track record of customer obsession, making product decisions from real customer contact rather than assumptions, even when building deeply technical systems

Experience building for industrial, manufacturing, supply chain, field service, or dealer and distributor network contexts

Demonstrated ability to go deep on hard technical problems, holding your own with engineers and unintimidated by retrieval systems, model behavior, or domain complexity

Working knowledge of modern AI concepts and systems such as LLMs, prompting, retrieval, and agents, with the judgment to translate them into reliable, user-facing products

Experience at a high-growth startup, especially early enough that you defined process rather than inherited it

Hands-on background in applied AI or ML products, having prototyped or shipped agents, retrieval systems, or workflow automation

Comfort being forward-deployed, spending real time on-site with customers to understand their workflows firsthand

Human Skills

Deeply empathetic with customers, but proactive and commercially minded. You surface expansion opportunities rather than waiting to be asked

Strong communicator, written and verbal, with the ability to build trust at multiple levels of an organization

Organized and detail-oriented, with strong follow-through on commitments

Curious and adaptable in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

Collaborative across Sales, Product, and Leadership with low ego and high ownership

Not For You If

You prefer managing a backlog over owning an outcome.

You want a mature product with established patterns rather than an emerging category with open questions.

You'd rather operate from a strategy deck than from time with real customers and real code.

You are uncomfortable with the unglamorous, foundational work of making AI systems accurate, reliable, and trustworthy at enterprise scale.

Empowered Culture: We value autonomy, candor, and craft. You'll be trusted to lead.

Meaningful Impact: Shape a platform that transforms how organizations activate knowledge.

Holistic Benefits: Competitive comp, equity, 100% paid healthcare, 401K, flexible PTO, and a team that truly cares.

If you want to own product at a company solving a real problem, helping the world's leading manufacturers unlock AI across their sales and service operations, and you're ready to take core product areas from first customer problem to production and scale, we want to talk.

Job Title: Senior Product Manager - Asset Health

Location: Austin, TX

At BusPatrol, we’re on a mission to make school transportation safer for children and communities. As a leader in AI-powered safety solutions, we bring cutting-edge technology—AI, machine learning, and IoT—to school buses across North America. We’re the most trusted stop-arm safety program globally, delivering transparency and safety at scale. In short, this is purpose driven work that measurably changes behavior in the communities we serve.

Key Outcomes:

This role is critical to transforming how we think about the health and lifecycle of our units deployed in the field and the experience of numerous internal and external stakeholders (target users). High-level goals for this new capability include:

Reduce mean time to resolve (MTTR) for bus and hardware issues by 25–50% within 12 months.

Increase in-field uptime of critical hardware kits (e.g., cameras, sensors, edge devices) by a defined target (e.g., X%) through improved monitoring, diagnostics, and maintenance workflows.

Clarify and prioritize asset criticality, enabling operations teams to focus on buses and routes with the greatest safety and enforcement impact.

Improve detection, triage and automated remediation of asset issues (e.g., false alarms, connectivity problems, firmware regressions) through better dashboards, alerts, and root-cause analysis tools.

Strengthen collaboration between Product, Hardware, Firmware, Data, Operations, and Support, with a shared set of metrics and a transparent roadmap in Jira.

Responsibilities

Own the Vision & Roadmap

Define the strategy for Asset Health across BusPatrol’s hardware portfolio, with a clear, data- driven strategy for reliability, availability, and lifecycle management.

Balance user empathy with enforcement rigor to drive behavior change.

Make clear trade-offs between short-term reliability fixes and longer-term platform investments, ensuring we build for scale.

Lead with Data and Insight

Define and own key performance indicators for Asset Health (e.g., MTTR, failure rates, uptime, alert precision/recall).

Leverage strong analytical skills to do impact sizing, opportunity assessment, and “Fermi style” estimation to guide decision-making.

Establish feedback loops with internal users and customers to continuously refine problem definitions, success metrics, and solutions.

Design for Predictive Maintenance & Operational Excellence

Partner with Hardware, Firmware, and Data teams to design telemetry and diagnostics needed to predict failures before they affect service.

Define health indicators and thresholds (e.g., error rates, connectivity drops, temperature, performance degradation) and ensure they are surfaced in usable tools.

Build or enhance internal tools, dashboards, and workflows that help Support and Operations quickly identify, triage, and resolve asset issues.

Incorporate behavioral design principles so internal users know when to act, what to do, and how to prioritize among competing alerts.

Drive Experimentation in a Regulated, B2G Environment

Innovate testing to design pilots, phased rollouts, and proxy metrics that work in a B2G context.

Collaborate with government partners and school districts to validate changes within legal and contractual frameworks.

Use structured experimentation and strong metrics to de-risk changes that affect enforcement, evidence quality, and service levels.

Foster Cross-Functional Alignment

Act as a quarterback for a broader set of teams when issues are root caused to various layers in the technology stack, hardware, firmware, software, human process

Partner closely with many stakeholder groups across the company

Communicate roadmap and trade-offs clearly to executives and external partners.

Champion Governance, Safety & Compliance

Ensure asset-related data and monitoring solutions respect privacy, retention, and evidentiary requirements, in collaboration with Legal and Compliance. Especially navigating these challenges from outside the United States.

Balance the need for rich telemetry and model training data with evolving data privacy and retention constraints.

Advocate for transparency and auditability in the systems that support enforcement and evidence integrity.

What You Bring:

7+ years in product management, with experience in predictive maintenance, asset monitoring, or similar, especially in B2G.

Experience working with hardware + software products (e.g., cameras, sensors, IoT devices, edge computing, or telematics).

Strong analytical skills, comfortable with proxy metrics, impact sizing, and experimentation.

Ability to navigate ambiguity and regulatory complexity with creativity and rigor.

Exceptional communication skills for executive and government audiences.

Experience in automated traffic enforcement or fleet safety is a strong plus.

A bias for action, the experience to lead from the front, and the wisdom to empower others while leading from the back.

Proven ability to lead cross-functional strategic initiatives with senior executives.

Strong data science and analytical skills with experience in sizing, Fermi style estimation, impact analysis, metrics, experiments, and measurement.

Comfortable with ambiguity, developing clear and concise priorities and roadmaps.

Demonstrated track record of leading cross-functional initiatives that involve senior executives and multiple stakeholder groups.

Experience collaborating with distributed teams across time zones; comfortable working remotely from India while partnering closely with North American counterparts.

Why Join Our Team?

If you are a builder of new teams, capability and solutions this is right up your alley!

Smaller company = more impact, faster.

Private equity backed.

Purpose-Driven Work that protects kids and communities.

Innovative work in an AI company.

A distinctive culture that helps you become the next best version of you while: “doing well by doing good.”

Competitive Package: Enjoy a competitive salary, incentives, and benefits in a rapid growth company.

Travel: up to 20%

No direct management, but direct influence and dotted line reporting from SMEs.

How We Work:

At BusPatrol, we uphold four core pillars:

Safety: We prioritize safety in every decision we make.

Connection: We foster strong relationships and opportunities for growth.

Excellence: We strive for quality and innovation in all that we do.

Impact: We measure success by fulfilling our mission and delivering results.

What We Offer

BusPatrol employees get:

A competitive salary and benefits package

Comprehensive personal time off, including volunteering and birthday days off

An opportunity to help build a company dedicated to children’s safety

The chance to join an innovative and dedicated team, focused on leading edge technology

The ability to contribute to purpose driven work that makes a difference in the lives of real people every day.

Additional Details

BusPatrol’s school bus safety programs are violator-funded, meaning that those who break the law pay for the technology that protects children. We build solid partnerships in the communities in which we operate which, coupled with our innovative business model, leads to sustainable efforts to change driver behaviors.

We are looking for a valued member of the BusPatrol team to assist us in our quest to improve children’s safety. This is an important role for us and a great opportunity for the right candidate. Our environment is inclusive, diverse, ignited, built on integrity, and deeply committed.

This position exists to drive growth by deeply understanding customer-specific requirements, translating them into differentiated rack platforms, and shaping the portfolio to win at scale.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. Within AIS and Data Center Engineering, the Mechanical Products and Services team is driving rapid innovation in mechanical cooling and controls systems used by AWS. Our engineers solve challenging technology problems and take big bets on new concepts, enabling AWS services to continue to revolutionize the industry. This role provides the opportunity to work closely with our team of innovative mechanical engineering builders developing and deploying the next generation of liquid cooling infrastructure for our data centers.

AWS is seeking a Principal Technical Product Manager for our team developing new infrastructure solutions that enable at-scale deployment of the latest liquid-cooled racks into our data centers. We are looking for an individual contributor with excellent people skills and prior liquid cooling system level development experience to define the strategy, provide technical guidance, and lead the team to execute against this strategy. Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About the work

We're changing how Scribd builds — and this role drives that forward. An agentic engineering stack is our competitive edge — turning AI leverage into real velocity: iterating fast to find the right direction, then moving with conviction. The foundations are taking shape — Claude Code in every engineer's hands, a plugin marketplace, an internal app platform in development, and the skills and conventions that make them effective in our codebases. The next chapter is making that stack the operating system every function at Scribd builds on top of.

In engineering, more than 80% of our engineers use Claude Code daily, and AI now writes more than half of our new code — roughly 3× the industry median. Across the company, teams are exploring agentic workflows and building their first internal apps and tooling. The deeper transformation is still just beginning: redesigning how software gets built as AI agents take on more of the work and engineers direct and steer — and extending that pattern to every other function. That's where this role comes in.

About the role

This is a foundational hire — Scribd's first product management role pointed inward, with the company itself as the customer. You'll lead Scribd's AI transformation, with the developer platform as the center of gravity: helping define the agentic engineering stack and shaping the evolution of the developer & agentic experience at Scribd. From that foundation, you'll extend the same thinking outward — partnering with Product, Design & Research, Data & Analytics, and TPM as they redesign their own work around AI agents, and guiding the internal app and agent platforms that every function depends on.

To do this well, you'll spend real time with developers and eng teams — understanding how they work today, where the friction lives, and what the next leap looks like for them. You'll lead the product strategy for developer experience and how we measure it — quantitatively and qualitatively. You'll bring the same lens to the parallel transitions in other functions at Scribd. Across all of it, your job is to help us adopt AI thoughtfully and prove its impact — not to scale AI generation for its own sake, but to make every function more capable and more confident in the outputs.

This role reports to the Director, Developer Platform, and partners closely with Engineering and Product leadership.

About you

You are energized by hard, ambiguous, cross-functional problems where the technology landscape is moving faster than ever, adoption is uneven across functions, and the platform is actively evolving as it ships. You have spent enough time close to engineering to reason about platforms, APIs, and agent systems on their own terms — and enough time across functions to know that adoption is a people problem at least as much as a technical one. You are comfortable being the first PM in a new domain, defining the role as you go with no pre-existing playbook to inherit.

You are all-in on AI reshaping every kind of knowledge work across a company, and you have already been applying it to your own. You think in systems and feedback loops, and you see the difference between how work happens on paper and how it actually gets done. You prefer structural guardrails over non-enforced guidelines. You'd rather ship and learn than wait for perfect, reserving real caution for the rare decisions that you can't easily reverse.

What you will do

Own the unified agentic enablement roadmap. Pull together the in-flight AI workstreams across Scribd into a cohesive, sequenced roadmap. Decide what is shared infrastructure and what stays function-specific. Make the tradeoffs visible to leadership.

Be the product owner for the internal app and agent platforms. Define and drive the product strategy for the platforms the company depends on — the internal app platform, the plugin marketplace, the agent runtime — and make sure they meet each function's real needs. You will partner with the Developer Platform and Data Platform engineering teams who build the underlying capabilities.

Translate between functions and the platform. Sit with different functions and their leaders to understand the workflows they are trying to redesign. Turn that into requirements we can build against, and turn the platform's capabilities into something every function can act on.

Drive cross-functional commitments to closure. Our AI Enablement strategy includes several load-bearing pieces of shared infrastructure — canonical context, the evaluation practice, the plugin marketplace, the internal app platform, and a coherent context ownership map. Each has named owners across functions. Your job is to keep them moving in lockstep and surface the seams before they fragment.

Make agentic enablement legible to the company. Define the metrics that matter — adoption, throughput, time recovered, evaluation quality, impact — and report against them. Build the narrative that gets every function bought in.

Partner on go-to-market for internal users. Plan and run the rollouts, education, and feedback loops that drive measurable adoption — capabilities aren't done when they ship, they're done when each function depends on them. Treat internal rollouts with the same rigor we would treat an external launch.

We're looking for

7+ years of product management experience, with notable focus owning developer tooling, AI platforms, or internal productivity tools

Demonstrated success owning ambiguous, cross-functional product surfaces end-to-end — defining the strategy, sequencing the work, and shipping with engineering partners — without a pre-existing playbook

Hands-on experience shipping real products with modern AI/LLM primitives — prompting, evals, tool use, agentic workflows, MCP, plugin or skill ecosystems, or comparable concepts. You have built things with these primitives, not just written PRDs about them

Strong technical fluency to match. You can hold your own with engineers on system design, API tradeoffs, evaluation methodology, and agent architectures

A track record of being a trusted technical-strategy partner to engineering leadership, with influence at the architecture and roadmap horizon

Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can move between an engineering deep-dive, a function lead's strategy review, and an exec narrative in the same week

Comfort and ability to move things forward when working in conditions where priorities, scope, and ownership are still being defined

Bonus Points

A background that includes engineering, technical program management, or applied AI work in addition to product management — you have shipped production code at some point in your career

Experience as a PM, technical lead, or founder building internal-facing developer tools, AI platforms, or productivity products at scale

Direct experience with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or other agentic coding environments — as a power user, an enabler, or a builder

Familiarity with the operating realities of a multi-product subscription business and a software stack that spans Ruby, Go, TypeScript, Python, and the AWS/Databricks ecosystem

Prior experience standing up a new function or a new PM role in an organization

DESCRIPTION

What happens when you hand a product manager the keys to an AI-first team that opperates like a start up at Amazon scale? They build the future of security. Want in? Amazon Enterprise Security Products is a newly launched group building intelligent, cloud-agnostic security tools where AI isn't a buzzword on a roadmap slide — it's how we think, build, and ship. We need a Product Manager - Tech who can move at startup speed, obsess over customers, and shape products that don't exist yet, all at a scale most startups only dream about. This is not a "write requirements and wait" PM role. You'll be in the room (and in the code reviews) with engineers, security researchers, and applied scientists, turning ambiguous customer problems into shipped products. You'll define what we build, why we build it, and how fast it gets to customers. Short feedback loops. Real ownership. No layers between you and the impact.

Key job responsibilities
* Own product strategy and vision end-to-end: Define and drive the roadmap for AI-powered security products from zero-to-one and beyond. You're not inheriting a backlog; you're creating the product direction for a team that's building the future of enterprise security tooling.

* Be the customer obsession engine: Deeply understand the security practitioners, CISOs, and enterprise teams we serve. Conduct ongoing customer research, validate hypotheses fast, and translate pain points into products people actually want to use not just products they're told to use.

* Drive AI-first product thinking: You don't need to write the model, but you need to understand what agentic architectures, conversational interfaces, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent orchestration make possible; and translate that into product experiences that feel like magic to customers. Stay ahead of what's emerging and experimental; bring the "what if we could…" energy every day.

* Ship like a startup, plan like a strategist: Lead implementation planning, prioritization, and phased rollouts alongside engineering. Write crisp product requirements that drive agentic development processes, define use cases and KPIs, and drive the hard tradeoff conversations. You own outcomes with the autonomy and accountability that comes with a high-trust, small team.

* Partner across disciplines with zero friction: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers, applied scientists, UX designers, security researchers, and leadership. Small team means your voice shapes direction immediately. The best idea wins here, regardless of title or tenure.

* Prototype, validate, iterate — relentlessly: Bring a builder's mindset to product management. Leverage AI tools and techniques (yes, even the experimental ones) to accelerate research, synthesize insights, generate artifacts, and move faster than any PM org you've been part of before.

* Define the multi-cloud, cloud-agnostic story: Understand and synthesize security technologies across AWS and competing cloud environments. Our customers operate everywhere, your product strategy needs to protect them wherever they are.

* Build the product culture from the ground floor: You're not joining a mature PM org, you're helping define what product management looks like on a fast-growing, AI-first team. Establish the rituals, the frameworks, and the bar. In the process, you become the kind of PM who has shaped a product category, scaled a team, and defined how modern security software gets built.

A day in the life
No two days look the same and that's the point. You might start your morning reviewing customer interview notes and reshaping a feature spec using AI-assisted writing tools, then jump into a design session where your product instincts collide with a principal engineer's architecture vision (and something better emerges). After lunch, you're demoing a prototype to a customer, pressure-testing assumptions in real time. By end of day, you've reprioritized a sprint based on what you learned, drafted a strategy doc for a new capability no one's built before, and pinged the team with three ideas you had on your walk. Your work reaches production fast and you see customers react in real time, not quarters later.

About the team
Amazon Enterprise Security Products is built by builders who tackle challenges others might consider too ambitious. We're a small team where there are no layers between you and the decision, no waiting quarters to see your work reach customers. Every team member brings an owner's mentality. If there's a problem worth solving, we solve it. No mission is beyond reach, no detail beneath our attention. We move fast, we ship fast, and we learn from what we ship. This is where builders, who want to make the impossible routine, come to do their best work.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences.
